notes: Godan verb. The kanji 描く has two readings: in everyday speech, drawing a picture is usually pronounced かく (kaku). The reading えがく (egaku) is more formal or literary, and is also used for portraying a theme in art or picturing something in one's mind.

faults.why: In everyday speech 描く is normally read かく for drawing pictures; えがく is literary/figurative.
